At a glance

Competitive research is all research financed by funds allocated on a competitive basis by the European Union, by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF), or by the Swiss Innovation Agency - Innosuisse

items.title: ERC
items.html:
The ERC are prestigious funds from the European Research Council. They are assigned on a competitive basis and represent the international value of the funded research. To this day, active or formerly active USI researchers were awarded 32 ERCs:
